events.content:
The migration is complete and the build passes. Here's a summary of everything that was migrated:

## Migration Summary

### Pages Router API → App Router API replacements

| Pages Router | App Router | Key Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Layout wraps `{children}` instead of `<Component {...pageProps} />` |
| `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | `<Html>`, `<Head>`, `<Main>`, `<NextScript>` replaced with standard `<html>`/`<head>`/`<body>` tags |
| `pages/index.js` | `app/page.tsx` | `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component with `headers()` + `cache: "no-store"` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `getStaticProps` with `revalidate: 60` → `fetch()` with `next: { revalidate: 60 }` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`; `getStaticProps` → async Server Component; `notFound: true` → `notFound()` from `next/navigation` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | Custom 404 page convention |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` | `getInitialProps` → `"use client"` error boundary with `error`/`reset` props |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `handler(req, res)` → named `GET`/`POST` exports using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `req.query` → `params` Promise; `res.status().json()` → `NextResponse.json()` |
| `next/head` (`<Head>`) | `export const metadata` | Static metadata via `Metadata` type; dynamic via `generateMetadata` |
| `useRouter` from `next/router` | `useRouter` from `next/navigation` | Client-only; extracted into `"use client"` components |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Converted to TypeScript with `"use client"` directive, proper types |

### Files created (all TypeScript with types)

```
app/
├── layout.tsx              # Root layout (replaces _app.js + _document.js)
├── page.tsx                # Home page (Server Component)
├── NavigateToBlogButton.tsx # Client component for router.push
├── not-found.tsx           # 404 page
├── GoBackHomeButton.tsx    # Client component for router.push
├── error.tsx               # Error boundary (client component)
├── blog/
│   ├── page.tsx            # Blog list (with ISR revalidation)
│   ├── BlogPostCard.tsx    # Client component for router.push
│   └── [id]/
│       ├── page.tsx        # Blog post (with generateStaticParams)
│       └── BackButton.tsx  # Client component for router.back
└── api/
    └── posts/
        ├── route.ts        # GET/POST handlers
        └── [id]/
            └── route.ts    # GET/PUT/DELETE handlers
```

### Files removed

The entire `pages/` directory and `components/AppProvider.js` have been deleted.
